definitions.short: Beeshterah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1203. Beeshterah בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָה proper name, of a location (? = עשׁתרה בֵּית = house of Ashtoreth , compare below בית ) a Levitical city in Manasseh Josh 21:27 ; = עַשְׁתָּרוֺת 1Chr 6:56
definitions.rootNote: from 6251 (as singular of 6252 ) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;

occurrences.englishText: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
